title: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
abstract: arXiv:2610.34177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measure

translated_title: 冻结已稳定之处，缓存平滑之处：空间冻结使步间缓存保持在其低误差区间
translated_abstract: 基于扩散 Transformer 的指令式图像编辑器需要运行数十个去噪步骤。无需训练的加速方法要么跨步骤复用特征（步间缓存），要么停止计算编辑未触及的区域（区域冻结），此前已有将两者结合的工作。我们探讨在追求高加速目标时应如何在两者之间进行分配。在 Qwen-Image-2.1 上，冻结的作用不只是移除 token：它还降低了每一步的计算成本，因此步间缓存可以用保守的阈值达到相同的整体加速，同时将误差保持在较低水平。一个基于开发集运行数据拟合的逐步成本模型，在留出样本上的延迟预测中位误差为 4.0%，并复现了我们重新实现的区域方法的加速上限（RegionE 的预测加速为 2.73 倍，实测为 2.70 倍）。将冻结的 token 引导至模型的单步 x₀ 估计值，在所有开发样本上都优于将其恢复为参考图像，并且在 90% 的实测样本中……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现空间冻结不仅能移除 token 还能降低每一步的计算成本，使步间缓存可以在保守阈值下保持低误差并共同达到更高加速，同时建立了预测延迟中位误差仅 4.0% 的逐步成本模型来指导两者分配。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that spatial freezing does more than remove tokens—it lowers per-step cost, allowing step caching to stay in its low-error regime with a conservative threshold, and introduces a per-step cost model that predicts latency with only 4.0% median error.
